meta.source: preview.html blueprint (:root variables and rules) + brand board screenshot, 2026-09-29

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background. Source --bg (light) and footer ground (dark). Text on it: ink, ink-muted, brand-text.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, diagram nodes. Source --card (light); dark reuses the brand green as the raised surface. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, brand-text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows and inset wells. Source th background (light). Text on it: ink, ink-muted or brand-text, all 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: surface-cream
tokens.usage: Soft highlight panels and tag hover. Source --cream (light). Text: ink.

tokens.name: surface-callout
tokens.usage: Gold-ruled callout ground (source .callout). Text: ink.

tokens.name: surface-danger
tokens.usage: Warning callout ground (source .warning). Text: ink, danger.

tokens.name: surface-tag
tokens.usage: Tag pill fill. Text on it: brand-text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken, surface-cream, surface-callout, surface-danger. Source --ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary and caption text on surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken, surface-cream and surface-callout (4.6:1 to 5.5:1 in the light theme, 4.6:1 on the sunken table-header tint). Deepened slightly from the source --muted #657068 so it passes on the header tint.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary fill: solid buttons, active tab, selected node. Text on it: on-brand. Source --green (light).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (11.8:1 light, 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Deep green used as text or icon ink: headings, table headers, nav links, tag text. On surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken, surface-tag in both themes.

tokens.name: green-accent
tokens.usage: Mid green for node outlines, connector lines and active step marks (source --green2). 5.8:1 on surface-page light; meaningful lines only, never body text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold as text, icon, outline, connector or highlight ring on cream surfaces (surface-page, surface-card, surface-sunken, surface-cream, surface-callout): 5.0:1 on surface-page, 4.6:1 on surface-card and 5.1:1 on surface-cream in the light theme, deepened from the brand gold #c99b3b to pass. In the dark theme it is the brand gold (4.6:1 on surface-card). For solid gold fills use gold-bright.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: The brand gold #c99b3b as a FILL: Shop Now and Add to Cart buttons (text: on-gold), the second line of the hero title and every gold mark on hero-deep (5.8:1). On hero-mid it is 3.8:1, so use it there only for 24px+ text and graphics. Never text or a line on cream (2.3:1); use gold there. In the high-contrast theme it is lightened to #e3b448 (7:1 on hero-deep) and only ever used as a fill or on hero surfaces.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on gold-bright fills (6.4:1). Do not use on gold in the light theme.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Warning text and cancelled state, always beside a word. On surface-card and surface-danger. Source --red (light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative; control borders use brand or green-accent). Source --line.

tokens.name: hero-deep
tokens.usage: Start of the hero gradient and the dark feature panels. Text on it: on-hero, white, gold.

tokens.name: hero-mid
tokens.usage: End of the hero gradient (135deg from hero-deep). Text on it: on-hero, white, gold.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Lead paragraph text on hero-deep and hero-mid (12.6:1). Source .lead.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code and pre blocks in both themes. Text on it: code-ink. Source pre background.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Text on code-bg (14.6:1). Source pre color.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset; 5.8:1 on surface-page light, 6.6:1 on surface-page dark, 4.6:1 on surface-card dark.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title, one per page. Fluid in source: clamp(40px,6vw,72px). Set the second line in gold-bright on hero-deep.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Premium sliced and packed fruit boxes for your daily freshness.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Firebase is the source of truth. Excel is the reporting layer.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Actual delivery promises depend on operating capacity.
styles.usage: Captions and helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrow badges and lane names. Set uppercase.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Prices and stat numerals, in brand-text.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, field names, IDs and sheet columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between chips and icon labels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Table cell padding vertical, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Diagram node padding, inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards (source .grid).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding and page gutter.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Space above a sub-heading following a card grid.

tokens.name: space-58
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Top padding of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Callouts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes, buttons in dense UI.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tables and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, buttons (fully rounded at these heights).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the detail panel. Source --shadow.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, centered with space-24 gutters.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Width of the slide-open detail panel beside a diagram.
